question: Two right prisms have the same height, but their bases are triangles with areas in the ratio 3:5. What is the ratio of their volumes?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ **Volume of a right prism** = **Base Area** × **Height**. Since both prisms have the **same height**, the **Volume** is **directly proportional** to the **Base Area**. Ratio of Volumes = Ratio of Base Areas. Given Base Area Ratio = 3 : 5. **∴ The correct answer is 3:5.**
